selected_skill.name: seo
selected_skill.rationale: Popular low-sensitivity sales-marketing skill that can be simulated locally with a realistic site, crawl service, and release gate without requiring private marketing accounts.

design_goals: Require the solver to use a live local SEO audit chain rather than stale snapshots.
Exercise page remediation, legacy URL normalization, internal discovery-path fixes, sitemap inclusion, and evidence-backed reporting.
Keep with_skill and without_skill identical except for environment/skills presence.
verifier_focus: all target pages satisfy the live release gate after rebuild
keyword coverage and report outputs match the live audit state
legacy competing URLs are normalized and removed from the effective release surface
solver consulted the local seo-audit service before verifier
input packets and hidden audit service were not modified

oracle_validation.local: smoke-pass: live release gate cleared with official solution in a patched local mirror of the container filesystem
oracle_validation.e2b: pass: official solution cleared 11/11 verifier tests in isolated E2B runtime

contrast_experiments.isolation: with/without differ only by environment/skills presence; Dockerfile conditionally copies skills when present.
contrast_experiments.notes: Representative without-skill failure is action-level: the agent did not query the live release gate before verifier, leaving live blockers unresolved.
